proposal.description: fault_arbiter's valley-sample cycle boundary is taken from the masked, registered gate PWM_out instead of the synchronised modulator PWM, so each per-cycle CP sample lands one clock after the modulator's turn-on edge
proposal.reason: pwm_mask registers its output, so PWM_out rises one clock after Osc_sync. The BLANK_CLKS lookback then reads the CP comparator 4 clocks before the modulator edge instead of 5. A CP_trig excursion that sits only in that one-clock band is now counted, or now missed, so the fault counts and the window_trip/window_trip_SS hiccup exits (seen on En) change for the same CP_trig/Osc_in stimulus.

proposal.description: pgood_gen counts its qualifying switching cycles on falling edges of the masked gate PWM_out instead of the synchronised modulator PWM
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with the comparator good, the qualify counter now steps on PWM_out falling edges. These lag Osc_sync by one clock when the pulse is not truncated and come earlier when pwm_mask cuts it at the ceiling. So PGOOD and switch_supply assert on a different clock from the one the modulator cycle count gives.

proposal.description: fault_cause's 'converter running' scope takes soft_start's SS_done ('ramp finished') instead of the supervisor's ss_active ('in S_SS'), so faults during the ramp are outside the episode
proposal.reason: While in S_SS before the ramp completes, SS_done is low. A window_trip_SS hiccup, or OTP/UVLO/latch faults that end soft start, therefore set no FAULT_CAUSE bit and no fault_time, and a later SPI read of the fault log returns zero. The same faults in S_RUN are still logged.
